description: Creates a new website project. Xodia supports React + Vite and plain HTML sites: by default it starts from the Xodia template (React + Vite: Vite + React Router + Tailwind v4); `template` "html-vite" starts a plain HTML site with Vite instead. `templateId` starts it from a Marketplace template instead, with the same checks as Create from template in Xodia: free templates and paid ones the workspace bought, that fit its plan (a template with more pages than the plan edits comes in with the extra pages locked). Use the id the user names, or the template= part of the template's Marketplace link in Xodia; app starters: "bookings" (a bookings app: people sign in, book a time and see their own bookings), "members-directory" (a members directory: signed-in members browse each other's profiles and edit their own), "larch-room" (an app starter), "brasswick" (an app starter), "wendlow" (an app starter), "pinfold" (an app starter), "merrin-ash" (an app starter), "slipwell" (an app starter). An unknown id answers with the ids this workspace can use. Other frameworks (Next.js, Astro, React Router framework mode) can't be started here. Then call open_workspace.

template.description: What the site starts from: "react-router" (React + Vite, the Xodia template, default) or "html-vite" (plain HTML with Vite). Ignored with templateId

templateId.description: Optional: a Marketplace template id to start from (free, or paid and bought by this workspace). Only when the user asked for that template or an app starter
